basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old living in Chicago, struggling to make ends meet with rising living costs. I work part-time in retail while trying to break into the tech industry through online courses. My interests include cars and music, particularly guitar instrumentals. I often browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently single, I’m focused on building a stable financial future.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of retail operations from my job and am currently self-teaching programming through online courses. My interest in cars is more of a hobby, fueled by online research and community discussions.
